title: Are there any successful indie games that use AI-generated assets?
author: baruhspinoza
selftext: I’m curious if there are any examples of games that have actually achieved commercial success while using AI-generated art, animations, music, or other assets.

replies.author: Live_Length_5814
replies.body: Do Nintendo developers disclose it? They don't have to. But some developers like level-5 have been called out and apologised.

comments.author: EpicOfBrave
comments.body:
GTA, Battlefield, WoW and many more.

Photoshop, Substance Painter, ZBrush, Alchemist, even Blender has now MCP, basically every 3d generation software uses AI to help you generate content.

replies.author: -Unpaid_Wizard-
replies.body: "GTA, Battlefield, WoW, CS, DOTA and many more." Those are indie games? Wow, learn something new every day.

comments.author: boxing-boxing
comments.body: I'm getting some success with mine.   New players trying it every day!

comments.author: KlemiX
comments.body: The answer is every single successful indie game 😄

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: Almost all big major companies use AI, but since they are so big no need to disclose that information

replies.author: CruelAngelsThesaurus
replies.body: Oh you mean those ones that are hemorrhaging losses and cutting every project because of it?

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Exactly! 👍🏼 gotta know how to use the legal tax system to get ahead.

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: Also dimwreath uses it just released and successful

comments.author: dcboelte
comments.body: If your game is legitimately fun and it doesn't look like slop/ass, I think you'll be fine. If you're heart is in the right place (making a great game with ai assistance) and not trying to make a quick buck by vibe coding, people will play your game.

replies.author: Yamhar
replies.body:
This,

It’s about still leaving a human creative touch whilst keeping the fine line of using AI alongside it

comments.author: CruelAngelsThesaurus
comments.body:
This comment section is a load of bullshit.

Most of the people in here don't even seem to understand the difference between AI and Gen AI.

It's actually embarrassing to have to be pushed to a space that we have to share with absolute morons just because we use AI to make things we like.

There needs to be a clear division in people that use AI to help them and who use AI to do the bare minimum.

But yes, the answer to your question is yes.  
Clair Obscura admitted to using Gen AI for templates, and there are probably a few but that one was big enough to speak for any others I can't name right off rip.  
Aniimo is also currently doing pretty good and it's AI city.

  
The reality is that if you make something good enough, the majority of people really wont care, there is just so much damn slop in this community that it's going to be faced with scrutiny every.single.step.of.the.way.

You can thank the loudest of the morons for that. I'm sure I'll end up banned for calling attention to it cause we are suppose to just belly up and be nice while they stomp on everything.

comments.author: lyeeedar
comments.body: Mine is currently getting commercial success, enough that I quit my job to work on it full time. The game title is Ascend from Nine Mountains
